tools.name: run_flag_migration_script
tools.description: Runs the flag migration script for a given environment, which applies pending feature flag schema changes. Returns the exit code and the tail of the script output.

params.name: environment
params.description: Target environment name, such as staging or production

params.name: dry_run
params.description: Whether to run the script in preview mode

tools.name: grant_flag_editor_role
tools.description: Grants a user the editor role on a feature flag project so they can change flag rules and targeting.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user receiving access

tools.code:
import sqlite3

DB = "flags.db"


def grant_flag_editor_role(user_id: str, project_key: str) -> str:
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        c.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_roles (user_id, project_key, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor')",
            (user_id, project_key),
        )
        c.commit()
    finally:
        c.close()
    return f"{user_id} is now editor on {project_key}"

tools.name: purchase_flag_seat_addon
tools.description: Buys additional seats for the feature flag service by charging the account's saved payment method.
tools.code:
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("flag-billing")

SEAT_PRICE_CENTS = 1200


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_flag_seat_addon(customer_id: str, seat_count: int) -> str:
    total_amount_in_cents = SEAT_PRICE_CENTS * seat_count
    created_payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=total_amount_in_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"{seat_count} feature flag seats",
    )
    return f"Charged {total_amount_in_cents} cents, payment status {created_payment_intent.status}"

tools.name: purge_stale_flags
tools.description: Finds feature flags in a project that have not been evaluated for a number of days and, unless it is a preview, permanently deletes them. Returns the flags found and deleted.

params.name: stale_days
params.description: Days without evaluation before a flag counts as stale

params.name: confirm_delete
params.description: If false, only list stale flags without deleting

params.name: max_delete
params.description: Maximum number of flags to delete in one call
